description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the Thunder project, including warning event handling and warning reporting control. It contains interface declarations for warning events and control units, including methods for cloning, configuration, and report management.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, cloning, and description.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for a warning reporting unit that can report warning events and manage categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface within IWarningReportingUnit for controlling warning report categories—includes methods for exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event identified by an identifier and warning information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific warning category such as whether it's default, enabled, excluded, and configuration details.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a warning reporting control to a category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a warning reporting control from a category list.
